subject.title: [Feature]: Reusable gateway WebSocket client SDK package

question: Should OpenClaw publish a supported raw Gateway WebSocket client SDK now, and if so what API, transport-adapter, device-storage, and security boundaries should be committed to?
rationale: The current code is an internal private package around authentication and device-token behavior; publishing it would create a public security and compatibility contract that automation should not choose unilaterally.

options.title: Sponsor public SDK design
options.body: Keep this issue open while a maintainer defines the package name, supported runtimes, device storage contract, versioning, docs, and security review gate before publication.

options.title: Route users to high-level app SDK only
options.body: Use the existing @openclaw/sdk direction as the public app-client surface and close or narrow this raw gateway-client package request after maintainer confirmation.

options.title: Defer public client packages
options.body: Continue documenting Gateway protocol/RPC as the supported external integration path until maintainers are ready to publish a versioned client package.

recommendation.title: Sponsor public SDK design
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open while a maintainer defines the package name, supported runtimes, device storage contract, versioning, docs, and security review gate before publication.

likelyOwner.reason: The current internal gateway-client extraction and @openclaw/sdk package history route the API/package-shape decision through steipete's recent merged work.
